settings.heading: Built for the three conditions masah turns on.
settings.body: Waterproof. Structured to hold its shape. Shaped to stay on the foot. Those are the physical properties the practice turns on, and they are the ones we can speak to.

settings.heading: The three properties the conditions rest on.

settings.title: Waterproof
settings.body: A licensed Porelle® membrane sealed inside a three-layer knit. The same membrane and the same structure as every other pair we sell.

settings.title: Holds its shape
settings.body: Structured so it stands upright unsupported rather than collapsing when it is not being worn.

settings.title: Stays on the foot
settings.body: Shaped to stay put through a normal day of walking, without being tied or fastened to the leg.

settings.heading: Not something a brand can award itself.
settings.media_alt: HydroSox wudu design sheet: structured construction that holds its shape, shaped to stay on the foot
settings.head_note: Certification is not something a brand can award itself. The day a certifying institution names this product, it will be stated here with the name of the body that issued it and nothing more.
